style: Spacecraft and space-station surfaces: labs, hazard markings, armor, composites and heat shields.

cells.name: lab
cells.prompt: Clean white laboratory wall made of large square panels with thin precise seams.

cells.name: hazard
cells.prompt: Worn diagonal yellow-and-black hazard stripes painted on steel, scratches and chipped paint.

cells.name: blasted-steel
cells.prompt: Sandblasted steel plate with fine uniform matte grain and faint handling marks.

cells.name: welded-steel
cells.prompt: Steel plates joined by visible weld seams in a cross pattern, heat tint near the welds.

cells.name: armor
cells.prompt: Dark gunmetal armor plate with chamfered corners, recessed bolts and panel seams.

cells.name: carbon-fiber
cells.prompt: Woven carbon-fibre composite with a diagonal 2x2 twill weave.

cells.name: oxidized-hull
cells.prompt: Oxidized grey spaceship hull plating with chipped paint, corrosion blooms and rivets.

cells.name: ablative
cells.prompt: Pale grey ceramic ablative heat-shield tiles in a square grid with scorched edges.

cells.name: anodized-aluminum
cells.prompt: Brushed anodized aluminium with fine horizontal brushing lines.
